subject: Request: Catalyst Labs pilot surge — combined credits + discount approval
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Catalyst Labs pilot surge — combined credits + discount approval

Team —

Catalyst Labs (Samir / Elena) just confirmed an accelerated pilot expansion: they want to double their token throughput for the next 12 weeks and push to production gating by mid-November. To keep momentum, they're asking for a short-term economics adjustment: a one-time grant of 60,000 free credit units (for prefix caching and evaluation cycles) plus a 20% discount on usage for the trial extension period (first 3 months).

Why: they need predictable low unit cost during benchmarking and want Redwood as the primary inference runtime for two internal POCs. They also asked for priority onboarding support (1x dedicated SE hours / week).

Impact: my estimates (see attached pricing-breakdown.xlsx) show the one-time credit has an NPV cost of ~USD 18k at current rates; the 20% discount across the 3-month extension carries a potential delta of ~USD 45–60k depending on actual consumption. Combined net impact ~= USD 63–78k.

Ask: Exec approval to grant the 60k credit + 20% discount for a 3-month extension, with the condition that Catalyst signs the attached SOW (SOW-Catalyst-v2.pdf) and commits to a technical onboarding plan. Legal needs the greenlight to prep the contract redline and Finance needs a billing instruction if approved.

Timing: Catalyst wants an answer by EOD Friday (9/3) to keep their internal steering committee aligned.

Attachments: SOW-Catalyst-v2.pdf (draft SOW), pricing-breakdown.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
- Aditya / Marissa: quick approval or counter (pricing/tenor)
- Ben: confirm whether priority SE hours can be scheduled under our onboarding pool this quarter
- If approved, I will send a DocuSign + updated SOW to Samir/Elena and loop Legal/Finance.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.com]
[attachment: SOW-Catalyst-v2.pdf (application/pdf)]
[attachment: pricing-breakdown.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Catalyst Labs pilot surge — combined credits + discount approval

Thanks for the write-up, Jasmine. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I sign off:
1) Is the 60k credit strictly one-time for evaluation (non-refundable) or do we need to treat it as an accounting credit that reduces invoiced amounts?
2) The 20% discount — does it apply to all hosted usage tiers (including embeddings) or limited to generation tokens?

From a risk perspective I want to ensure we don't create precedent for similar-sized credits for comparable early-stage customers without a purchase commitment. If Catalyst will add a 6–9 month commit after the pilot we can justify a larger bridging concession.

If you can confirm the mechanics (answer the two Qs) I can approve escalation for the discount within the existing promo authority. If Finance requires an exception, I'll loop CTO leadership.

— Aditya
Director, Revenue Operations
[aditya_rao@redwood.com]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@catalystlabs.ai>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@catalystlabs.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Catalyst Labs pilot surge — combined credits + discount approval

Aditya — answers inline: 
1) Credit mechanics: one-time prepaid credit we will apply to Catalyst's account as a promo credit (reduces invoices until exhausted). Finance prefers to see it as a contra-revenue promo rather than a liability.
2) Discount scope: ask is 20% across hosted inference usage only (generation + chat endpoints). Embeddings are excluded. I can scope the SOW to clarify.

Catalyst is willing to sign a 3-month SOW extension that includes a firm statement of intent to evaluate a Dedicated conversation by Q1 if benchmarks meet latency/cost targets. Not a commit, but a formal evaluation clause we can use to justify the concession.

I've attached the SOW draft and the pricing sheet. If we can greenlight by EOD Fri, I'll issue DocuSign and set up a kickoff for next Monday with SE scheduling.

Samir / Elena — appreciate the quick turnaround on the ask.

— Jasmine

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Catalyst Labs pilot surge — combined credits + discount approval

Jasmine / Aditya — I can approve the 60k one-time promo credit and the 20% discount for the 3-month extension on the following conditions:
- Catalyst signs the SOW as-is (no unilateral pricing changes) and accepts a usage review checkpoint at month 2.
- Discount only applies to hosted inference endpoints (confirming the exclusion of embeddings).
- We cap the maximum discount exposure at USD 75k; Finance to put an internal contra-revenue flag for tracking.
- Priority SE support limited to 6 hours / week for the first 4 weeks, then reassess.

If those conditions look good to the account team and legal, you have my approval to proceed. Please follow the usual legal sign-off cadence and notify me once DocuSign is in flight.

— Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations
[marissa.cole@redwood.com]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@catalystlabs.ai>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@catalystlabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@rednerd@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Catalyst Labs pilot surge — combined credits + discount approval

Samir / Elena — good news: we have conditional exec approval. Summary of approved concessions: 
- One-time promotional credit: 60,000 units applied as an account promo (applies to hosted inference usage).
- Usage discount: 20% off hosted inference usage for the 3-month extension. Embeddings excluded. Discount exposure capped at USD 75k.
- Priority SE support: up to 6 hours/week for the first 4 weeks.

Conditions: 
1) Please sign the attached SOW (SOW-Catalyst-v2.pdf) and return via DocuSign.
2) We will include a month-2 usage checkpoint; if consumption goes materially beyond projections we may revisit economics.
3) The promo credit is applied at invoice time as a contra-revenue promo.

I've asked Legal to prepare the DocuSign and Finance will attach the contra-revenue tracking. Scheduling for SE hours will follow once we've got the signed SOW.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/ABCDEF-123456
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/987654321

Appreciate the fast coordination everyone — I'll send the DocuSign now.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.com]
